messages.貫通の広域(攻撃加重値は解析Ⅳで7)で、破裂・出血・暴食脆弱をまとめて配り、貫通: A multi-target Pierce E.G.O (7 Attack Weight at Threadspin Ⅳ) that hands out Rupture, Bleed, and Gluttony Fragility together, with Pierce buffs and Bind that make later fighting easier.
messages.広域のばらまき: 攻撃加重値5(解析Ⅳは7)で、Ⅰコインが的中時に破裂2、表面的: **Multi-target spreading**: 5 Attack Weight (7 at Threadspin Ⅳ); Coin Ⅰ inflicts 2 Rupture on hit and 2 Bleed on Heads Hit.
messages.暴食脆弱: 解析Ⅲから的中時に暴食脆弱2を付与する。暴食スキルが多い破裂編成と噛: **Gluttony Fragility**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 2 Gluttony Fragility on hit. It meshes with Rupture teams that have many Gluttony skills.
messages.パッシブ「不信の枝」: ターンごとに貫通ダメージ量増加1を得る。表面的中時は次の: **Passive — Stem of Distrust**: Gains 1 Pierce DMG Up every turn. On Heads Hit, inflicts 1 Bind next turn and Rupture Count increases by 1.
messages.安定した威力: 威力19~26(解析Ⅲは22~29)で最低値が高く、精神力が低く: **Stable power**: Power 19–26 (22–29 at Threadspin Ⅲ) with a high minimum, making it easy to win even at low SP.
messages.暴食と傲慢の資源が重い(色欲2・暴食3・憂鬱1・傲慢4)ので、片方は編成で賄う前: Its Gluttony and Pride costs are heavy (2 Lust, 3 Gluttony, 1 Gloom, 4 Pride), so build the team assuming one of those is covered by teammates.
messages.敵が多い場面で撃ち、束縛で次のターンの速度差を作ると、速度差を活かす破裂人格が動: Fire it when there are many enemies, and use Bind to create a Speed difference next turn so Rupture Identities that use Speed difference can act more easily.
messages.精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。侵蝕スキルは威力が上がる強化版(解析Ⅲで的中時に破: Sanity cost is 20 for both Awakening and Corrosion. The Corrosion skill is an enhanced version with higher power (5 Rupture, 5 Bleed, and 3 Gluttony Fragility on hit at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が3上がり、暴食脆弱の付与が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises by 3, and Gluttony Fragility infliction is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が7になる。火力は攻撃加重値7の他のE.G.Oに劣ると考えられ、: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 7. Its damage likely falls behind other 7-Attack-Weight E.G.O, so it serves to add options.
messages.黒獣-卯: S1〜S3と守備が破裂の付与か破裂回数の増加を持ち、S2・守備(暴食: **[Heishou Pack - Mao Branch](persona:1112)**: S1–S3 and her Defense skill inflict Rupture or increase Rupture Count, and S2, her Defense skill (Gluttony), and S3 (Gloom) also supply the required affinities. She uses Speed difference, meshing with Bind.
messages.南部セブン協会6課部長: S1・守備が暴食、S3が色欲で資源を出せ、S1・S2は: **[Seven Assoc. South Section 6 Director](persona:1104)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Gluttony and S3 is Lust, supplying resources, and S1 and S2 inflict and increase Rupture.
